title: Chapter 260
text:
No pop-up window, free to read!

You have received [Recoil – Thorns]!

You have received [Steel Body]!

A wave of numbness flowed through his entire body like an electric current. Han Xiao's spirit was lifted. He stretched out his arms and felt that his body had become stronger. He clenched his fist and pounded his chest twice, making a thick muffled sound.

"I'm walking further and further down the road of being a meat shield." Han Xiaoxin was very happy, very satisfied with this round of harvest.

This was the second Molding Ability that he had obtained. True Damage ignored Defense Reduction and directly dealt damage to the interface. For example, the theoretical damage of an attack was 100 points, but when it actually landed on the target, it would be reduced by the target's Defense. True Damage, on the other hand, ignored Defense and directly dealt 100 points of damage.

With this ability, his HP would be more secure, and he would become more and more like a boss.

After tidying up his attribute interface and leveling up [Magnetic Ring Mechanic] to the max level, he still had 125 million EXP left. He then leveled up the two new skills, [Machinery Continuation] and [Recoil — Thorns], to the max level and spent another 13 million EXP. He also obtained two more Potential Points. The more Potential Points, the better.

These two abilities were very useful. [Machinery Continuation] was not worth mentioning. Its effect was comparable to a mechanical Viagra. [Recoil — Thorns] could be used as a strong defensive skill. When faced with an attack that was too strong, it could be used to offset a portion of the damage.

[Magnetic Ring Mechanic] had been maxed out, and a new Class Advancement condition had appeared.

"As expected." Han Xiao's eyes flashed.

The Class Advancement requirements for certain stages of the main class were fixed. He currently had four stages of the Mechanic class: Mechanic Novice, Mechanic Apprentice, Mechanic Trainee, and Magnetic Ring Mechanic. The Class Advancement requirements for all Mechanic class players were the same.

Only by learning enough advanced knowledge and having a high enough intelligence could one enter the next stage.

"My Intelligence Attribute is 321 points, and my Free Attribute Attribute is 40 points. In that case, I'm still 39 points away from the requirement. That's why I need to look for a Subclass and grind my level to Level 80."

Even though he had put all his points into Intelligence, he still could not meet the requirements for the Class Advancement. As for the Mechanic players who did not know, they could only bitterly look for more subclasses.

The level cap in Version 20 was Level 90. The higher the level, the more experience required to level up the subclass. Therefore, if the subclass requirements were not met, they would have to pay a higher price. If the subclass took up too much of the total level, their combat strength …

In his previous life, there were some players who only met the requirements to change their class after reaching Level 80. Their main class had only leveled up a few times before they reached the upper limit of the version … Unsurprisingly, PvP was the place that these players hated the most.

Han Xiao threw all 40 Free Attribute Points into Intelligence and muttered, "I also need to find a subclass. My strength has already surpassed the version requirement, so there's no need to rush to level up. Hmm … it's best to find a rare subclass. That way, I'll have more Free Attribute Points and complete the class change requirement with the lowest level …"

He was not worried about the advanced knowledge. His growth speed had exceeded the version, which was why it was difficult to obtain the advanced knowledge. He would get it sooner or later.

"Hey, Black Phantom, can you return my weapon to me?"

Someone called out to him from behind. Havalen walked over and asked.

He was the Mechanical Pugilist who used the power hammer. The power hammer was still in Han Xiao's hands, and he had not returned it to him.

Han Xiao turned around and said righteously, "Well, I've checked it before. Your weapon has a serious malfunction. I'll return it to you after I fix it."

What he meant was, "Hmm, I'll return it to you after I figure out the blueprint."

Havalen had a suspicious look on his face. "Malfunction? It was fine when I used it."

"It's a battle. Injuries are inevitable."

"Er, this is a secret product of the Theseus Military. My superiors told me not to leak it …" Havalen was troubled. Han Xiao was a mechanic, so he was very worried.

Han Xiao said righteously, "That's not right. Do I look like that kind of person? We're teammates now."

He did not feel guilty at all. Teammates had to be sold. Otherwise, what was the difference between him and a salted fish?

Havalen hesitated for a few seconds and sat back down helplessly.
